extract_choice_response: extract a single letter choice from an LLM sample string like 'a', 'a)', or 'foo(a)bar'
extract_parenthesized_choice: extract a parenthesized single letter choice from text formatted as 'lorum(a)ipsum'
dynamically_adjust_temperature: adjust LLM sampling temperature based on the number of failed attempts so far
review_sampling_utils: review the sampling utility module that extracts choices and adjusts temperature for LLM sampling
test_extract_choice_response: test the extract_choice_response function with various LLM sample string formats
